# Define the mapping of song titles to release dates (MM/YYYY)
release_dates = {
    "Lost in the Embrace of Night": "03/2021",
    "Lonely Skies": "11/2022",
    "Caught in a Web of Lies": "03/2021",
    "On the Border of Reality": "08/2022",
    "A Love That Never Was": "10/2020",
    "Astral Serenity": "12/2019",
    "Between Reality and Reverie": "03/2020",
    "Strangers Again": "06/2022",
    "The Mirage of a Perfect Life": "11/2020",
    "Wilted Roses on the Vine": "02/2020",
    "When All Words Fail Us": "07/2020",
    "Final Echo": "07/2022"
}

# Get the current note content
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=simple_note_token)
content = note['content']

# Split into lines and replace TODO for each song
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    # Check if line contains a song we need to update
    for song, date in release_dates.items():
        if song in line and 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
            line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {date}')
            break
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)

# Verify all TODOs are replaced
remaining_todos = [l for l in new_lines if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in l]
print("Remaining TODOs:", remaining_todos)
print("New content preview:")
print(new_content)
